requested_brief.generic_fallback_name: Friendly feathered bird inspired by Archaeopteryx
requested_brief.purpose: Scene-enriching original static prop for an imaginative world aimed at young children; artistic colors/textures/pose/proportions are welcome.

subject.pose: Static low standing pose with one slightly opened wing and a clear feathered tail.

requested_brief.claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired art with basic recognizable anatomy. Not strict scientific reconstruction; no exact locomotion, life-history, coexistence or animation-readiness claim.
requested_brief.distinctness: Long feathered bony tail and clawed wing edge are primary distinctions; no modern soaring gait is asserted.
requested_brief.publication_authority: User has authorized QA-passed batches to push/merge without per-model approval; release is parent-coordinated after CI gate. This planning branch must not merge main.
requested_brief.coverage_justification: Eight useful fixed views inherited from approved v002, exact GLB multi-angle runtime inspection; no production turntable sequences. Add a targeted view for an actual issue.

scale.kind: art-direction choice, not a newly measured fossil dimension

requested_brief.style: Natural refined low-poly, credible proportions and soft transitions. User rejected v001 art direction.
artistic_choices: Suggested palette: muted charcoal, rust and warm gray feather blocks
Nominal size, proportions, pose, missing fine parts and simplified detail are artistic.
Tiny subjects need close placement or an explicit creative display-scale choice; do not promise readability from a distant island camera.
Opaque or economical portable materials are preferred. Fine translucent/vein/feather detail is optional when it does not survive normal viewing.
requested_brief.acceptance_policy: Current delegated request and approved v002 style override conflicting archived model/style/coverage/budget rules. Unknown required gates remain blocked.
requested_brief.review_bound: One consolidated independent basic-form/aesthetic review, at most one planned cosmetic repair; record minor tradeoffs and continue without individual user approval. Real technical/identity blockers receive targeted repair.

criteria.description: Exact standalone GLB validates and reimports; no missing dependencies, nonfinite geometry or broken units/origin; budgets measured and warnings dispositioned.

Readable distinct core form in the eight fixed QA views; no conspicuous unintended penetration, detached major parts or clearly broken shading. Minor color/facet differences and artistic choices are advisory.
Stylized-inspired basic-form obligation: Feathered early-bird form with a long underlying bony tail carrying feathers along its length.
Stylized-inspired basic-form obligation: Use a modest toothed jaw and a readable suggestion of clawed wing fingers without adding a separate extra arm pair.
Stylized-inspired basic-form obligation: Keep two legs and two coherent feathered wings; do not make a modern short-tailed bird or pterosaur membrane.

Editable source, deterministic generator/config, standalone GLB, original maps if used, exact hashes, eight fixed QA views and one hero poster. Label stylized-inspired and static; include actual source/generator/config hashes in the final versioned execution brief.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader; record bounds, material/texture metrics and errors.
Inspect this exact GLB in a declared graphics runtime. Record renderer/device; a SwiftShader PASS is functional software-render evidence, not physical GPU/device performance.
Inspect a neutral simple prop benchmark with the exact GLB and recorded visible copy count/work. Do not require current-museum integration or scientific coexistence for this asset brief.

requested_brief.research_boundary: The archived research gate is preserved. This creative production scope does not certify that every fossil question has been resolved.

budget_intent.policy: 14k triangles and 1,000,000 bytes are ceilings, not targets. Usually aim about 100–500 KB; below this range is fine. Spend more triangles only for visible silhouette/proportion/connection benefit. Do not pad counts or enlarge textures for apparent refinement. Preserve quality if a justified asset exceeds the usual range within the hard caps.

reference_policy.scope: Child-friendly static stylized-inspired environment prop; no strict scientific reconstruction.
reference_policy.minimum_reference: Use a reliable named museum/specimen/institution or primary reference supporting recognizable basic form; existing ledger entries are retrieval leads with inherited access notes, not a new verification by this planning task. Group-only overview cannot prove a genus-specific diagnostic feature. No mandatory species/specimen matching beyond the basic form actually claimed.
reference_policy.reference_rights: Consulting facts does not require licensing a copied asset. References are consulted-only, with source URLs and actual access status retained. No reference media/scan/mesh is incorporated. If incorporating third-party media, record actual rights/license/permission first; the string consulted-only is not a third-party license grant. Prefer original geometry/maps and avoid this dependency.
reference_policy.continue_rule: Once reliable basic form and original/authorized inputs are established, proceed after the parent CI/claim gate. Do not repeatedly research or repair because color, restored soft tissue, pose, dimensions, plate/feather counts or fine reconstruction are uncertain. Label artistic choices.
reference_policy.block_only: A real basic identity contradiction, no reliable support for the named form actually claimed, unlicensed incorporated material, visibly broken proportion/connection at intended view, or failed required technical/delivery checks remains actionable. Narrow unsupported claims to the descriptive inspired-by fallback; do not invent sources or a factual PASS.
reference_policy.repair_bound: One consolidated independent QA and at most one planned cosmetic repair as the inherited practical profile specifies; persistent required defects return to parent for scope/hold decision rather than an open-ended reconstruction campaign.

requested_brief.quality_boundary: Recognizable natural refined child-friendly prop; uncertain fine reconstruction is advisory, not a reason for repeated rework.
